lines.text: Sammy the snail crawled along the mossy path, inch by steady inch!
He watched hummingbirds zip and bunnies sprint across the garden grass!
I want to be fast right now! Sammy grumbled, trying to slide at super speed!
Zoom! Speedy rabbit dashed past like a whirlwind, not looking where he was going!
Whoosh—CRASH! Rabbit tripped over a garden hose and lost his strawberry basket!
Sammy steadily glided forward, picking up each strawberry with careful care!
He delivered the basket safely without bruising a single delicious fruit!
Slow and steady finishes the race with patience and excellence!
Take your time and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for fun learning!
